scope: Per-term R_n cyclic relation, P_k linear projection, and I_i,j virtual image documentation data for the twenty System 5 Terms; not executable behavior and not a runtime mapping

cyclic.name: Cyclic Relation (Relational Whole)
cyclic.definition: A directed arc of a closed counter-current circuit between interfaces; each documented R_n closes against its counter-current partner as one Relational Whole

projection.name: Linear Projection
projection.definition: An open unidirectional path through interfaces that does not return to its source; paired projections form a double-entry account of what is received and what is expended

virtualImage.name: Virtual Image
virtualImage.definition: A mutually closed virtual relation between closed interfaces i and j of the (3,4,5) triad, generated by triadic double identity while the coalesced (1,2) pair relates from within each closed interface

sources.location: Full term descriptions for the twenty System 5 Terms
p. 5 token-structure crosswalk; p. 51 virtual-image count; p. 66 R1/R2 definition; pp. 68-69 primary hierarchy
Page 1 (OCR) including the Virtual Image figure
Consolidated registry, evidence matrix, and conflict register

evidence.claim: Twenty System 5 Terms described with interface configurations, expressive and regenerative modes, and cross-term sequence links
Two Relational Wholes R1 and R2 are defined with counter-current feedback across a perceptually transposed interface (System 3 Universal Term 2, p. 66)
Primary Universal Hierarchy stacks interface (1) inside (2) inside (3) inside (4) inside (5) and specifies all five interfaces in all 20+ Terms including Expressive and Regenerative Modes

When the five interfaces are separate, (3), (4), (5) form a mutually closed triad while (1) and (2) coalesce, generating three mutually closed virtual images relating emotional virtual identity to virtual routines and virtual form
Three of the 20 Terms of System 5 have virtual images; Term T1-2 is one of them (p. 51)

T1-2 reflects the balance between two cyclic relations as a virtual conceptual image, with a bipolar relation created by the coalesced Host and Consciousness; OCR leaves the R subscripts partially illegible, reconstructed here as R1, R2, R3

P projections relate to the physical social marketplace in the expressive mode and project to the body's muscle spindles that generate proprioceptive sensory input in the Term 4R that follows; OCR leaves the P subscript illegible
In T8 the projections (Pk) account what was received and what was expended while the Relational Wholes (Rn) hold the counter-current balance of R1 and R2
The p. 5 crosswalk pairs numbered tokens T01-T20 with parenthesis structures and named objective/subjective variants
Ten provisional registry families with separate objective and subjective variant tokens
Documentation-grammar R_n, P_k, and I_i,j records are not runtime identifiers and do not map to executable Rn/Pk objects

series.name: Subjectively Oriented Autonomic Terms
series.pathway: Autonomic nervous system via the limbic system

series.name: Objectively Oriented Somatic Terms
series.pathway: Somatic nervous system via the sensory and motor cortices

series.name: Transjectively Oriented Universal Terms
series.pathway: Spans both series, transferring discretion and goal between them
